description: This AURES-related dataset describes financing conditions for onshore wind, offshore wind and solar photovoltaic projects in European countries. Eclareon and Technical University of Denmark researchers collected information between September 2019 and April 2020. Country and technology summaries include minimum, maximum and average debt costs, equity costs, debt shares, loan tenors, debt-service coverage ratios and weighted average cost of capital. Zenodo provides spreadsheet and CSV tables with survey questionnaires, free under CC BY 4.0. Technology coverage is limited and differs across countries, and these historical survey responses should not be substituted for current financing offers. They can parameterise investment and capacity-expansion scenarios, including sensitivity analysis around financing assumptions. The collection complements model-pypsa when users supply technology-specific financial parameters; no automatic software integration is claimed.
name: Financing conditions of renewable energy projects – results from an EU wide survey
